stories.Name_fr: Accords de service d'électricité pour les grandes charges
stories.Explanation: Electric service agreements signed with major customers for significant data center capacity.
stories.Signal: Major win in AI/data center infrastructure build-out with visible contract value.
stories.Description: In February 2026, Evergy signed electric service agreements with multiple large load customers to serve data centers with projected peak steady-state load of approximately 1,900 MW across multiple projects, with service expected to begin 2026-2028.
